x: Gowar, a time which only Langridge of South London has beaten over this course. Alan Black who finished third was unfortunate in going off the course at the half way stage and lost some 200 yards as a result.
…and Pat chased John Disley home in the 3 miles to finish less than two seconds behind in 14m.39 6s. and incidently beat Langridge of S.L.H. who is no mean performer.…

Heatley came up from ninth to take over the lead and to lower the course record by 17 seconds, whilst Pat, despite an excellent run, was pushed back to eighth by other "big-guns", namely Connolly, Craig, Langridge, and Herring.
